statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease
The patient has a history of supraventricular tachycardia
A 48-hour Holter monitor, CPT 93226, was ordered
The Holter monitor was ordered to evaluate for intermittent arrhythmias or ischemic changes contributing to symptomatic events
The relevant diagnosis codes are R55, I25.10, and I47.1
The service is not covered under the patient's current benefit plan
The denial reason code is PR-204
